name: 8digit-planner
description: 8digit Planner is a content calendar for creators, personal brands, studios and agencies who need a client or a teammate to approve posts before they go out. Upload finished photos and videos, plan posts, carousels, Stories and Reels, get them reviewed with timestamped comments and publish each approved post to your social accounts at its scheduled time. Guest reviewers do not need a seat. From your AI assistant, say “plan my first post”: it lists your brands, uploads the files you choose, drafts and schedules posts, asks for approval when you want it and publishes approved posts when you ask. Built for people who manage content for a brand, their own personal brand or their clients.
